selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What small part of the truths in the seas and rivers did the traveler understand?
questions.answer: He understood only a very tiny part of what they show.

questions.question: What message do the seas give with one united voice?
questions.answer: They point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How strong is the witness of the seas described to be?
questions.answer: It is described as strong in a way that matches their huge size.

questions.question: Who are brought forward as witnesses from the seas?
questions.answer: The living things inside them are brought as witnesses.

questions.question: What two kinds of water places are included in the testimony in this passage?
questions.answer: The seas and the rivers are included.

questions.question: What does the passage say all the seas and rivers together show about Allah?
questions.answer: They show that Allah truly exists and is One.

questions.question: Name one sign in the waters that supports this testimony.
questions.answer: Their being controlled and managed in an orderly way is one sign.

questions.question: Name another sign in the waters that supports this testimony.
questions.answer: The creatures in them being kept safe is another sign.

questions.question: What does wide and regular administration mean here?
questions.answer: It means the waters and what is in them are managed in a large, organized way.

questions.question: After looking at the oceans and rivers, what did the traveler realize about their proofs?
questions.answer: He realized they contain many truths and declarations about Allah.

questions.question: Did the traveler see all of those truths or only a little of them?
questions.answer: He saw only a little of them.

questions.question: In the passage, how do the seas speak if they do not use human words?
questions.answer: They speak through the signs found in them.

questions.question: What is the main belief that the seas announce?
questions.answer: They announce that only Allah is worthy of worship.

questions.question: Besides the seas, what other waters give the same testimony?
questions.answer: The rivers give the same testimony.

questions.question: What do all the creatures in the waters do in this description?
questions.answer: They serve as witnesses supporting that testimony.

questions.question: Which qualities of the waters are pointed out as signs of Allah’s existence: confusion or order?
questions.answer: Order is pointed out as a sign.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by mentioning preservation in the waters?
questions.answer: It teaches that what is in the waters is protected by Allah’s care.

questions.question: What does regular administration tell us about how the waters work?
questions.answer: It tells us they operate according to an organized plan.

questions.question: What did the traveler notice about the truths found in the seas and rivers?
questions.answer: He noticed that they hold far more truths than he could fully grasp.

questions.question: How do the seas give their testimony: separately or together?
questions.answer: They give it together, in agreement.

questions.question: What exact belief is supported by the testimony of the waters?
questions.answer: It supports belief in Allah alone.

questions.question: Who inside the waters supports this testimony?
questions.answer: All the creatures living in them support it.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect the strength of the testimony to the size of the seas?
questions.answer: It shows that their witness is huge and powerful, just like their vastness.

questions.question: What are four signs named in the passage that point to Allah through the seas and rivers?
questions.answer: Their being under control, being protected, having things stored in them, and being managed in an orderly way.
